summary: Practise OARS, SERVQUAL and complaint recovery methods for stronger service conversations. Explore the five-day course and plan your training.
lede: Active listening and emotional intelligence help service professionals understand customer needs and respond constructively in conversations. This intermediate course is for experienced customer service, contact centre and service operations staff who want to diagnose requests and complaints and improve follow-through. Practise OARS questioning, recognizing emotional cues, regulating your response and planning service recovery using conversation evidence.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who handle customer requests, complaints or service hand-offs and need to improve the quality of each conversation. It is designed for service practitioners with experience responding to customers and for specialists who coach, monitor or improve those interactions.
prerequisites: Prior experience handling customer requests, service enquiries or complaints is expected. No coding or programming is required. Familiarity with basic service-quality measures such as CSAT is useful but not essential.
